# SFX manifest — card-mosaic

Generated with MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0, 48 kHz mono Opus (96 kbps VBR, loudness-normalized; 100 inference steps).

|---|---|---|

| edge-match.opus | match | A bright small glass bell ting with warm resonance, like a glass mosaic tile settling exactly into place. |

| round-fail.opus | fail | Three soft descending wooden marimba notes fading out quietly, gentle disappointment without harshness. |
| hint-reveal.opus | hint | A soft magical shimmer of light wind chimes with a rising glint, as if a hidden spot on a board lights up. |
| achievement-unlock.opus | achievement | A cheerful ascending four-note glockenspiel fanfare ending on a bright sustained note, small award jingle. |
| pause-toggle.opus | pause | Two soft muted music-box plucks, high note then low note, like a small lid gently closing. |
| ui-open.opus | uiOpen | A soft wooden panel sliding open, gentle airy whoosh ending with a light click. |
| ui-close.opus | uiClose | A soft wooden panel sliding closed, gentle hushed whoosh ending with a quiet click. |
